messages:
anna_support: FYI — Acme (org_id=acme-9876) just escalated: user j.tanaka@acme.com gets 403 on Console -> Models and cannot see billing tab. Reports used to have deploy/model permissions.
sam_sec_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the user's Redwood user id and a screenshot if available?
anna_support: user_id: rwd_U12345. Screenshot attached in thread (screenshot shows console with 'You do not have permission to view this page'). Customer says they were fine yesterday.
diego_infra: I remember we rolled the RBAC refactor last night (role rename job). Let me check audit logs.
audit-bot: AUDIT: 2025-11-05T02:14:12Z policy_migration_job started by infra-deploy
audit-bot: AUDIT: 2025-11-05T02:14:45Z migrated roles for org acme-9876: 14 users updated
sam_sec_eng: Any diffs from the migration? Maybe a legacy role wasn't mapped.
diego_infra: Pulling the migration diff now. snippet:
```
- role: model_admin -> role: model_manager
- role: billing_viewer -> role: billing_reader
+ mapping: {model_admin: model_manager, model_owner: model_owner}
```
Looks like `model_deployer` wasn't included in the mapping for a subset of users.
irene_sre: That would explain missing deploy buttons (deploy permission is tied to model_deployer). Any chance those users had a custom role that referenced the old role id?
diego_infra: Yes — I found 3 users with custom_role -> inherited old role id `model_deployer` that wasn't translated. rwd_U12345 is one of them.
anna_support: Customer is asking for timeline — they are blocked from deploys. Can we grant them temporary access while we fix migration?
sam_sec_eng: We should avoid org_owner grants unless necessary. Two options: 1) temporary manual grant of `model_manager` via internal admin UI (audit will record), or 2) backfill migration script and re-run for affected org — heavier but cleaner.
diego_infra: I can apply a targeted backfill for the affected users in acme-9876. ETA ~20m. Will push migration-only for org filter.
irene_sre: Also add an alert rule: if post-migration there are >0 users with unmapped role refs, create a pager. This slipped through.
sam_sec_eng: Agreed. Also we need an incident note for security/compliance: record who changed mappings and that KMS keys and audit logs are intact. @audit-bot can you attach the migration-run logs to the ticket?
audit-bot: Attached logs to ticket #INC-2025-324.
diego_infra: Running backfill now: command:
```
./scripts/rbac_backfill --org acme-9876 --dry-run=false --map-file=/deploy/mappings/role_map_v2.json
```
...running
anna_support: letting customer know we're performing a scoped fix. They'll stand by.
anna_support: Customer confirms they can wait ~30m.
diego_infra: Backfill complete. 3 users updated (including rwd_U12345). Audit entry: `rbac.backfill: user=rwd_U12345 action=role_mapped to=model_deployer_mapped_by_v2`.
sam_sec_eng: Can we verify that the console shows the proper buttons for the user? @anna_support can you ask j.tanaka to retry and report exact UI elements?
anna_support: pinged the user. They report console now shows Models, Deploy, and Billing tab. Access restored :tada:
anna_support: Customer asks what caused this and what prevents recurrence.
irene_sre: Root cause: role rename/mapping migration missed a legacy role reference in custom roles for a subset of orgs. Migration code assumed canonical role ids only; didn't traverse custom role definitions. Fixes: 1) patch migration to traverse custom roles and map references; 2) add preflight check that lists unmapped refs and fails the job; 3) add integration test for mapping with custom roles.
diego_infra: I'll open a PR with the patch and include the unit/regression tests. Also scheduling a canary run on 2 orgs before global rollout.
sam_sec_eng: For compliance: record timeline and customer notification in the incident log, include audit log IDs, and confirm no KMS/HSM key operations were involved. KMS note: role change doesn't touch data keys; still we should verify key access logs just to be safe.
anna_support: I've updated the customer: access restored, root cause explained, we will run a full audit and follow up with timeline. They want the remediation ETA.
diego_infra: PR linked: https://repo.redwood.dev/rbac/migrate/pulls/42 — plan to merge after CI and canary. ETA 48h for global rollout. Backfill script available for support in meantime.
irene_sre: Postmortem action items assigned: @diego_infra add preflight check, @sam_sec_eng produce compliance note, @anna_support update the KB doc for support playbook (how to run targeted backfill).
anna_support: Marking resolved for this thread — customer happy and access restored. Will open follow-up ticket for the global fix and canary schedule.
sam_sec_eng: Thanks everyone. Quick win: create an alert that flags new role mapping migrations with >0 unmapped refs so support can intervene before blocking customers.
anna_support: Closing — will add the incident/ticket numbers to the customer email.
